requirements.value: License by endorsement available if the division determines the out-of-state license encompasses a similar scope of practice, applicant has at least one year of experience, and license is in good standing. Also available through Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) for RN/LPN and APRN Compact for APRNs.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grounds for refusal to issue a license to an applicant, for refusal to renew the license of a licensee, to revoke, suspend, restrict, or place on probation the license of a licensee, to issue a public or private reprimand to a licensee, and to issue cease and desist orders shall be in accordance with Section 58-1-401.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 401 - Grounds for denial of licensure or certification and disciplinary proceedings.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to safeguard a patient's right to privacy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to safeguard a patient's right to privacy as to the patient's person, condition, diagnosis, personal effects, or any other matter about which the licensee is privileged to know

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide nursing service in a manner that demonstrates respect for patient's human dignity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide nursing service or service as a medication aide certified in a manner that demonstrates respect for the patient's human dignity and unique personal character and needs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual relations with a patient during a professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in sexual relations with a patient during any: (i) period when a generally recognized professional relationship exists between the person licensed or certified under this chapter and the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exploiting or using information about a patient or exploiting the professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: exploiting or using information about a patient or exploiting the licensee's or the person with a certification's professional relationship between the licensee or holder of a certification under this chapter and the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully obtaining, possessing, or using any prescription drug or illicit drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unlawfully obtaining, possessing, or using any prescription drug or illicit drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unauthorized taking or personal use of nursing supplies from an employer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unauthorized taking or personal use of nursing supplies from an employer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unauthorized taking or personal use of a patient's personal property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unauthorized taking or personal use of a patient's personal property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful or inappropriate delegation of nursing care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unlawful or inappropriate delegation of nursing care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to exercise appropriate supervision of persons providing patient care under nurse's supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to exercise appropriate supervision of persons providing patient care services under supervision of the licensed nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding and abetting the employment of an unqualified or unlicensed person to practice as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employing or aiding and abetting the employment of an unqualified or unlicensed person to practice as a nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to file or record any medical report as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to file or record any medical report as required by law, impeding or obstructing the filing or recording of such a report, or inducing another to fail to file or record such a report

disciplinary_grounds.description: Breach of statutory, common law, regulatory, or ethical confidentiality requirements regarding a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: breach of a statutory, common law, regulatory, or ethical requirement of confidentiality with respect to a person who is a patient, unless ordered by a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with intent to conceal wrongful acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (i) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incapable of practicing nursing with reasonable skill due to illness, excessive drug or alcohol use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall recommend that the director file a petition with the division, and cause the petition to be served upon the nurse with a notice of hearing on the sole issue of the capacity of the nurse to competently, safely engage in the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 401 - Grounds for denial of licensure or certification and disciplinary proceedings.

citations.kind: qualifications for graduates of nonapproved programs

definition_quote.value: Practice of nursing means assisting individuals or groups to maintain or attain optimal health, implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment, and requires substantial specialized or general knowledge, judgment, and skill based upon principles of the biological, physical, behavioral, and social sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing" means assisting individuals or groups to maintain or attain optimal health, implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment, and requires substantial specialized or general knowledge, judgment, and skill based upon principles of the biological, physical, behavioral, and social sciences.

value: promoting and supporting human functions and responses
establishing an environment conducive to well-being
collaborating with health care professionals on aspects of the health care regimen
performing delegated procedures within education and skill of licensee
delegating nursing tasks to others including unlicensed assistive personnel
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of nursing" includes: (a) initiating and maintaining comfort measures; (b) promoting and supporting human functions and responses; (c) establishing an environment conducive to well-being; (d) providing health counseling and teaching; (e) collaborating with health care professionals on aspects of the health care regimen; (f) performing delegated procedures only within the education, knowledge, judgment, and skill of the licensee; (g) delegating nursing tasks that may be performed by others, including an unlicensed assistive personnel; and (h) supervising an individual to whom a task is delegated

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe or administer prescription drugs including local anesthesia, Schedule II-V controlled substances. A licensed APRN may prescribe or administer a Schedule II controlled substance except for CRNAs acting under the anesthesia provision.
drug_authority.quote: prescription or administration of prescription drugs or devices including: (i) local anesthesia; (ii) Schedule III-V controlled substances; and (iii) Schedule II controlled substances

value: advanced practice registered nurse - CRNA without prescriptive practice
license_tiers.quote: The division shall issue to an individual who qualifies under this chapter a license or certification in the classification of: (a) licensed practical nurse; (b) registered nurse apprentice; (c) registered nurse; (d) advanced practice registered nurse intern; (e) advanced practice registered nurse; (f) advanced practice registered nurse - CRNA without prescriptive practice; and (g) medication aide certified.
license_tiers.citation: Section 301 - License or certification required -- Classifications.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Role" means one of the four recognized roles of certified registered nurse anesthetists (CRNA), certified nurse-midwives (CNM), clinical nurse specialists (CNS) and certified nurse practitioners (CNP).
aprn_role_categories.citation: Section 101 - Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact.

value: other specified health care professional as defined by division rule
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: the performance of nursing acts in the generally recognized scope of practice of licensed practical nurses as defined by division rule made in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, and as provided in this Subsection (13) by an individual licensed under this chapter as a licensed practical nurse and under the direction of a registered nurse, licensed physician, or other specified health care professional as defined by division rule

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of any supervisory or collaborative relationship.
collaborative_practice_agreement_require.citation: Section 101 - Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of any supervisory or collaborative relationship.
full_independent_practice_available.citation: Section 101 - Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: has practiced for at least 2,080 hours as an APRN in a role and population focus congruent with the applicant's education and training.
full_independent_practice_experience_hou.citation: Section 101 - Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Except as provided in Subsection (2), a licensed advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe or administer a Schedule II controlled substance.
prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.citation: Section 803 - Limitations on prescriptive authority for advanced practice registered nurses.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescription or administration of prescription drugs or devices including: (i) local anesthesia; (ii) Schedule III-V controlled substances; and (iii) Schedule II controlled substances

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication aide certified" means a certified nurse aide who: (a) has a minimum of 2,000 hours experience working as a certified nurse aide; (b) has received a minimum of 60 hours of classroom and 40 hours of practical training that is approved by the division in collaboration with the board, in administering routine medications to patients or residents of long-term care facilities; and (c) is certified by the division as a medication aide certified.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: delegating nursing tasks that may be performed by others, including an unlicensed assistive personnel; and (h) supervising an individual to whom a task is delegated under Subsection (12)(g) as the individual performs the task.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: an individual may apply for a single-state license, instead of a multistate license, even if otherwise qualified for the multistate license.
multistate_license_option_available.citation: Section 101 - Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: the division, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, shall establish the Utah Professionals Health Program to provide an alternative to public disciplinary action for licensees who have substance use disorders.
impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 4a - Utah Professionals Health Program, Section 103
